behavior: dotf lessons index prints one row per lesson sorted by number, one section per category, and writes no file
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lessons/ -run '^(TestIndex_OneTablePerDirectorySortedByNumber)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestIndex_OneTablePerDirectorySortedByNumber ' "$o" && cd .. && cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^(TestLessonsIndex_PrintsTheTableAndWritesNothing)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestLessonsIndex_PrintsTheTableAndWritesNothing ' "$o"
